A colonnade of Araucaria monkey-puzzles receding in uneven ranks, wildly mismatched girths, rust-red bark striped with vertical resin flows that have hardened into organ-pipe ribs, black-green needle shade deepening between them, cone-littered litter underfoot, seen along the colonnade from between two trunks

One colossal Agathis-like kauri giant filling most of the frame, buttressed flanks running with thick amber sheets still wet at the leading edge, a pine cone stuck fast halfway down a flow, silver lichen across the upper bark, deep rust needle-litter below, tree ferns small behind it, seen from low at the base looking up

A leaning crooked grove of tall Cheirolepid conifers on a steep slope, every trunk tilted the same way, resin pooling and running down the low side of each in thick runnels, emerald moss cushions packed along the uphill roots, blue-grey depth between trunks below, seen from the litter looking up the slope flank

A blowdown tangle where a giant Araucaria has come over, its snapped stump weeping resin in broad wet sheets, the crater of the root-plate open to the sky, raw grey mud exposed at the base, cycads already pushing up in the new light, seen from the edge of the root crater looking across the break

A narrow gap between two close scaly-barked podocarps, the space between them strung with thin resin threads catching lateral light, the forest beyond showing as blue-grey shadow shapes, horsetails at the base of each trunk, bare grey mud in the gap itself, seen from outside looking through the hanging strands

A terrace of stepped ground descending in three levels, podocarps standing at each step, resin flows from the upper trunks joining the lower ones at each drop, rust needle-litter thick on every step, a ginkgo at the lowest level its fan-leaves lime-green, seen from the highest step looking down the joined flows

A clearing floor deep in hardened resin nodules scattered like marbles across rust-red needle-litter, a ring of Cheirolepid conifers standing around the edge, every trunk base glazed with old flows, silver lichen across the north-facing bark, one nodule cracked open showing clouded interior, seen low across the nodule floor

A shallow creek cutting through exposed Araucaria roots, its bed holding smooth resin lumps rolled like river pebbles, clear water running amber-tinted over them, emerald moss on the root flanks above the waterline, rust bark reflected in the still pools, horsetails crowding the near bank, seen from the creek bed looking upstream

A hollow burnt-out Agathis giant still standing, the scorched flank black and open, fresh resin boiling out of the char in bright orange runs still wet, the unburnt side carrying silver lichen and old hardened flows in dark ridges, tree ferns in the understory behind it, seen from inside the hollow looking out through the opening

A dense understory of tree ferns and cycads under tall Araucaria monkey-puzzles whose canopy nearly closes above, resin dripping from high branches and landing on cycad fronds in bright beads, deep rust needle-litter on the floor below, the trunks black-green in the low light, seen from the fern floor looking up through layered fronds

A colonnade of Agathis-like kauri trunks of wildly uneven girth, the widest one bearing a whole flank worn smooth into a single continuous glaze you could see reflected distortion in, black-green shade between the rest, fallen cones across deep rust litter, silver lichen high on the narrower trunks, seen from midway along the colonnade at trunk height

One colossal scaly-barked podocarp dominating the frame, a beetle-bored hole near eye-level with a fresh bead of resin swelling out of it like a blister, the surrounding bark orange-rust, younger podocarps small and blue-grey behind it, emerald moss across the root buttresses, seen from a step back at mid-trunk looking across the bored scar

A leaning grove of Cheirolepid conifers on a bare grey mud slope, claw-scores raked across a wide resin scar on the nearest trunk still filling slowly from the scored channels, rust needle-litter pooling against the uphill side of each root, horsetails at the base of the slope, blue-grey forest receding behind, seen from the litter looking up the scarred flank

A blowdown where a scaly podocarp giant has snapped, the standing stump weeping in long parallel sheets, a sapling Araucaria growing straight out of a resin-cemented crack at the base of the stump, the fallen trunk behind it carpeted in emerald moss, raw orange wood at the snap, seen from beside the stump looking along the fallen length

A narrow gap between two enormous Araucaria monkey-puzzles, their whorled branch-tips nearly meeting overhead, resin hanging in the gap as stretched bead-chains between the bark, cycads filling the floor on both sides, deep black-green shade beyond, bare grey mud in the slot itself, seen from inside the gap looking toward the light at the far end

A terrace cut by erosion into red laterite, three levels of Cheirolepid conifers standing at each break, flows from the top level running over the edge in a frozen curtain where they have hardened into a resin ledge, cone-litter caught along that ledge, ginkgo saplings at the base, seen from the lowest terrace looking up the curtain face

A clearing floor where the nodules are largest at the center and smallest at the ring's edge, Agathis trunks standing around the perimeter, one trunk at the ring's gap bearing an old flow hardened into a broad ledge a meter off the ground, rust needle-litter deep between nodules, seen from the gap trunk looking across the scattered floor

A creek bed running between Araucaria roots, resin lumps in it ranging from walnut-sized to cone-sized and all of them smooth, clear water splitting around the largest lump which is pale green where algae has taken the surface, emerald moss on the roots above, seen from the downstream side looking up into the root tangle

A hollow Cheirolepid giant standing open on one side, resin boiling from a fresh wound inside the char and running down the interior wall in a bright curtain, the outer bark silver-lichened and completely intact, tree ferns pressing close on both sides, needle-litter deep at the threshold, seen from inside looking out at the fern-framed opening

A dense understory of horsetails and tree ferns beneath a mixed stand of podocarps and Araucaria, resin beads on every cycad frond catching the light that filters through, the trunks rust-red above and black-green in shadow, one Araucaria trunk with a row of old flows hardened into raised ribs like a corrugated flank, seen from ground level looking up between fronds

A colonnade of scaly-barked podocarps, no two the same girth, the bark colour shifting from deep orange-rust on the fattest trunk to pale grey-silver on the thinnest, resin flowing exclusively from the mid-sized trunks and leaving the extremes dry, emerald moss only at root level, seen from one end of the colonnade in raking lateral light

One colossal Cheirolepid conifer filling the frame, its upper trunk invisible in black-green canopy, the resin on its flank accumulated so deep that the original bark texture is buried under a translucent skin and only a whorled branch scar interrupts the surface, cycad understory below, seen from close and low looking up the buried flank

A slope grove of Araucaria monkey-puzzles all leaning the same downhill direction, the resin on each collecting in the crook where trunk meets slope and building a drip-ledge on the low side, fallen cones rolling against those ledges and sticking there, blue-grey depth between trunks lower on the slope, seen from upslope looking down the leaning ranks

A blowdown tangle of two fallen Agathis giants crossing each other, each stump still weeping, the resin from both flows meeting on the ground between them and pooling in a broad slow lake, ginkgo seedlings at the pool's edge, raw orange wood at both snaps, seen from the edge of the resin pool looking toward the nearer stump

A gap between two Agathis kauri trunks so close that the resin from each has bridged across at one point and formed a horizontal bar you could pass under, the forest beyond showing as a blue-grey fade, horsetails at the base of each trunk, cone-litter on the grey mud below the bar, seen from outside looking through under the bridge
